verdict.rationale: Docs confirm local-rail smart routing (domestic bank rails used when currency/country match), multi-currency support (24+ currencies) and embedded FX conversion, plus payout mechanics via wallets/recipients — directly addressing local-currency payouts and FX handling. However, evidence lacks concrete documentation on payout timing/settlement SLAs, fee transparency for FX conversion rates, or independent/hands-on confirmation that sellers actually receive local-currency payouts as described. missing for 10: independent corroboration of settlement speed/cost, explicit FX rate/fee documentation, and real-world seller payout confirmation.
